title: प्रधानमन्त्रीको भारत भ्रमणबारे यस्तो छ परराष्ट्र सचिवको ब्रिफिङ (पूर्णपाठ)
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालयले प्रधानमन्त्री बालेन्द्र शाहको भारत भ्रमणबारे आज औपचारिक जानकारी गराएको छ । प्रधानमन्त्री आइतबार भारत प्रस्थान गरी सोमबार फर्किने छन् । भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री नरेन्द्र मोदीको निमन्त्रणामा शाह भारत जान लागेका हुन् । उनको भ्रमण दलमा दुई मन्त्रीसहित ३४ सदस्य रहने जानकारी गराइयो । ५२ जना व्यवसायी र केही पत्रकारहरु आफ्नै खर्चमा भारत जाने भएका छन् । प्रधानमन्त्री शाहले भारतीय राष्ट्रपदी द्रौपदी मुर्मी, प्रधानमन्त्री मोदी, विदेशमन्त्री एस जयशंकर लगायतसँग भेटवार्ता गर्ने कार्यक्रम छ । आजको पत्रकार सम्मेलनमा परराष्ट्र सचिव अमृत राईले गरेको व्रिफिङ यहाँ जस्ताको तस्तै प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ- सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यूको आसन्न भारत भ्रमणका सम्बन्धमा जानकारी उपलब्ध गराउने उद्देश्यले आयोजित यस पत्रकार सम्मेलनमा यहाँहरूलाई हार्दिक स्वागत छ। सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यू भारतका प्रधानमन्त्री महामहिम श्री नरेन्द्र मोदीज्यूको मैत्रीपूर्ण निमन्त्रणामा यही २२-२३ नोभेम्बर २०२६ तदनुसार २०८३ मङ्सिर ६ र ७ मा भारतको दुईदिने राजकीय भ्रमणमा जाने कार्यक्रम तय भएको छ । सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यू २०८३ मङ्सिर ६ गते आइतबार मध्याह्न १:४५ बजे नेपाल वायुसेवाको नियमित उडानबाट भारत प्रस्थान गर्नुहुने कार्यक्रम रहेको छ । उहाँको भ्रमण टोलीमा माननीय अर्थमन्त्री डा. स्वर्णिम वाग्लेज्यू, माननीय परराष्ट्रमन्त्री श्री शिशिर खनालज्यू, प्रधानमन्त्रीका मुख्य सल्लाहकार, राजनीतिक सल्लाहकार लगायतका उच्चपदस्थ अधिकारीहरू, बिजनेस डेलिगेसन, पत्रकार लगायतका टोली रहेको छ। नेपालबाट प्रस्थान गर्ने सरकारी भ्रमण दल ३४ सदस्य रहेको छ भने त्यसमा नयाँ दिल्लीस्थित नेपाली राजदूतावासबाट महामहिम राजदूतसहित केही सदस्यहरू थप हुनुहुनेछ । भ्रमणमा निजी क्षेत्रबाट ५२ सदस्य व्यवसायीहरूको टोली आफ्नै खर्चमा सहभागी हुनुहुनेछ । यसैगरी भ्रमणको रिपोर्टिङका लागि निजी खर्चमा नेपालका विभिन्न सञ्चार माध्यमहरूलाई प्रतिनिधित्व गर्दै पत्रकारहरू पनि जानुहुनेछ। भ्रमणका क्रममा सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यूले उहाँका भारतीय समकक्षी महामहिम श्री नरेन्द्र मोदीसँग २०८३ मङ्सिर ७ गते प्रतिनिधिमण्डलस्तरीय वार्ता गर्नुहुनेछ । भ्रमणका क्रममा दुई देशबीच सम्पर्क सञ्जाल विस्तार तथा ऊर्जा सहकार्यसम्बन्धी विभिन्न परियोजनाहरूको उद्घाटन तथा नयाँ परियोजनाहरूको शिलान्यास गर्ने कार्यक्रम रहेको छ । नेपालका लागि भारत एक ठूलो र महत्त्वपूर्ण साझेदार राष्ट्र हो । दुवै देशका नेतृत्वहरूबीच व्यापार, पारवहन, लगानी, ऊर्जा, सम्पर्क सञ्जाल तथा पूर्वाधार लगायतका क्षेत्रहरूमा आर्थिक सहकार्य अभिवृद्धि गर्ने विषयमा व्यापक छलफल हुनेछ । भ्रमणका क्रममा सहकार्यका विविध क्षेत्र शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, कृषि, खेलकुद, विपद् व्यवस्थापन, मानव संशाधन जस्ता विषयहरू समेटिएका विभिन्न समझदारीपत्रहरू समेत आदानप्रदान गरिनेछन् । यसबाट दुवै देशका प्राथमिकता प्राप्त क्षेत्रमा आपसी सहकार्य थप विस्तार हुन जानेछ । नेपाल-भारतबीच रहिआएको सदियौँ पुरानो सम्बन्धलाई थप सुदृढ गर्दै सहकार्य र सहयोगात्मक साझेदारीको भावना अनुरूप दुवै देशका प्रधानमन्त्रीहरूले नेपाल र भारतका लागि महत्त्वपूर्ण रहेका सम्पूर्ण विषयहरूमा छलफल गर्नुहुनेछ । द्विपक्षीय वार्तापश्चात् विभिन्न विषयहरू समावेश गरी दुई प्रधानमन्त्रीज्यूहरूले संयुक्त पत्रकार सम्मेलन गर्नुहुनेछ । सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यू र उहाँका प्रतिनिधिमण्डलको सम्मानमा भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री नरेन्द्र मोदीज्यूले आयोजना गर्नुहुने अफिसियल लन्चअनमा सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री सरिक हुनुहुनेछ । साथै सोही दिन भ्रमणका अवसरमा सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्रीज्यूले भारतका महामहिम राष्ट्रपति श्रीमती द्रौपदी मुर्मुसँग शिष्टाचार भेट गर्नुहुने कार्यक्रम तय भएको छ। यसैगरी आइतबार सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यूसँग भारतीय विदेशमन्त्री डा. एस. जयशङ्करले शिष्टाचार भेट गर्नुहुने कार्यक्रम तय भएको छ । भ्रमणका अवसरमा सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्रीज्यू नयाँ दिल्लीको राजघाटस्थित महात्मा गान्धीको समाधिस्थलमा गई श्रद्धासुमन अर्पण गर्ने कार्यक्रम पनि तय भएको छ। भ्रमणका क्रममा नेपाल-इन्डिया बिजनेस फोरमको छलफल कार्यक्रम हुनेछ । नेपालमा भारतीय लगानी आकर्षित गर्ने उद्देश्यले भारतीय व्यवसायी समुदायलाई सम्बोधन गरिने र व्यवसायी समुदायका चासो र सरोकारहरू सुन्ने र नेपाल सरकारको तर्फबाट भारतबाट थप लगानी आकर्षित गर्ने अवलम्बन गरिएका नीतिगत दृष्टिकोण तथा प्रयासहरू प्रस्तुत गरिनेछ । यो कार्यक्रम नेपाली र भारतीय व्यवसायीहरूबीच सहकार्य गर्ने सेतु पनि बन्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ। भारतको राजकीय भ्रमण सम्पन्न गरी सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यू नेपाल एयरलाइन्सको नियमित उडानबाट मिति २०८३ मङ्सिर ७ गते साँझ १८:३५ बजे स्वदेश फर्कनुहुने कार्यक्रम रहेको छ । यस भ्रमणबाट प्राप्त हुने उपलब्धिहरूले हाम्रा द्विपक्षीय साझेदारीलाई थप गति प्रदान गर्नुका साथै नागरिकले प्रत्यक्ष अनुभूति गर्न सक्ने ठोस उपलब्धि, ठोस लाभ प्राप्त गर्न महत्त्वपूर्ण योगदान पुर्‍याउने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । द्विपक्षीय सम्बन्धलाई थप मजबुत बनाउने दिशामा उच्चस्तरीय भ्रमणहरू अपरिहार्य हुन्छन् । हाम्रा दुई देशबीच इतिहास, सभ्यता, संस्कृति तथा जनस्तरको घनिष्ठ सम्बन्ध रहिआएको छ । आसन्न भ्रमणले नेपाल र भारतबीच रहिआएको मैत्रीपूर्ण एवं सहयोगात्मक सम्बन्धलाई थप उचाइ प्रदान गर्न समेत महत्त्वपूर्ण हुने विश्वास गरिएको छ । यस भ्रमणसम्बन्धी थप जानकारीहरू अघि प्रवक्ताले पनि भन्नुभएजस्तै हाम्रा वेबसाइट, सामाजिक सञ्जालहरू लगायतका माध्यमहरूबाट निरन्तर रूपमा सार्वजनिक गरिने नै छन् । यसैगरी भ्रमणपश्चात् त्रिभुवन अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विमानस्थलमा प्रेस ब्रिफिङको कार्यक्रम पनि आयोजना हुने नै छ । यस महत्त्वपूर्ण भ्रमणलाई सफल बनाउन आ-आफ्ना सञ्चार माध्यमबाट सकारात्मक कभरेज, धारणा, दृष्टिकोण, लेख, सूचना र जानकारीहरूको प्रसारण र सल्लाह एवं पृष्ठपोषण सहित यहाँहरूले पुर्‍याउनुभएको सहयोगका लागि परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालयका तर्फबाट म यहाँहरूलाई हार्दिक धन्यवाद ज्ञापन गर्दछु । साथै आगामी दिनमा पनि यहाँहरूको यस्तै सहयोगको अपेक्षा रहेको पनि जानकारी गराउन चाहन्छु । Kathmandu. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has today officially informed about Prime Minister Balendra Shah's visit to India. The Prime Minister will depart for India on Sunday and return on Monday. Shah is visiting India at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. His visiting delegation will reportedly consist of 34 members, including two ministers. 52 businessmen and some journalists will travel to India at their own expense. Prime Minister Shah is scheduled to meet Indian President Draupadi Murmi, Prime Minister Modi, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar, among others. The briefing given by Foreign Secretary Amrit Rai at today's press conference is reproduced here verbatim: A warm welcome to this press conference organized to provide information regarding the upcoming visit of Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah to India. Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah has been scheduled to pay a two-day state visit to India on 22-23 November 2026, corresponding to 2083 Mangsir 6 and 7, at the friendly invitation of the Prime Minister of India, His Excellency Narendra Modi. Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah is scheduled to depart for India on Sunday, 2083 Mangsir 6 at 1:45 PM on a regular Nepal Airlines flight. His visiting team includes Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle, Honorable Foreign Minister Mr. Shishir Khanal, high-ranking officials including the Prime Minister's Chief Advisor, Political Advisor, business delegation, journalists and others. The government delegation departing from Nepal consists of 34 members, and some members, including His Excellency the Ambassador, will be added from the Nepali Embassy in New Delhi. A 52-member team of businessmen from the private sector will participate in the visit at their own expense. Similarly, journalists representing various media outlets in Nepal will also go at their own expense to report on the visit. During the visit, Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah will hold delegation-level talks with his Indian counterpart, His Excellency Narendra Modi, on 2083 Mangsir 20. During the visit, various projects related to expansion of communication networks and energy cooperation between the two countries are scheduled to be inaugurated and the foundation stone of new projects will be laid. India is a major and important partner for Nepal. The leaders of both countries will have extensive discussions on enhancing economic cooperation in areas including trade, transit, investment, energy, connectivity and infrastructure. During the visit, various MoUs covering various areas of cooperation such as education, health, agriculture, sports, disaster management, human resources, etc. will be exchanged. This will further expand mutual cooperation in priority areas of both countries. Further strengthening the centuries-old relations between Nepal and India, the Prime Ministers of both countries will discuss all issues of importance to Nepal and India in the spirit of cooperation and supportive partnership. After the bilateral talks, the two Prime Ministers will hold a joint press conference covering various issues. The Honorable Prime Minister will attend an official luncheon hosted by the Indian Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, in honor of the Honorable Prime Minister, Shri Balendra Shah and his delegation. Also, on the occasion of the visit on the same day, the Honorable Prime Minister is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on the President of India, Mrs. Draupadi Murmu. Similarly, on Sunday, Indian External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on Honorable Prime Minister Shri Balendra Shah. On the occasion of the visit, Honorable Prime Minister is also scheduled to visit Mahatma Gandhi's memorial at Rajghat in New Delhi and pay homage. During the visit, a discussion program of the Nepal-India Business Forum will be held. With the aim of attracting Indian investment in Nepal, the Indian business community will be addressed and the interests and concerns of the business community will be heard and the policy approaches and efforts adopted by the Government of Nepal to attract more investment from India will be presented. This program is also expected to become a bridge for cooperation between Nepali and Indian businessmen. After completing his state visit to India, Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah is scheduled to return home on a regular flight of Nepal Airlines on 2083 Mangsir 20 at 6:35 PM. The achievements from this visit are expected to further accelerate our bilateral partnership and make a significant contribution to achieving tangible achievements and tangible benefits that citizens can directly experience. High-level visits are indispensable in further strengthening bilateral relations. Our two countries have a close relationship in terms of history, civilization, culture and people-to-people ties. It is believed that the upcoming visit will also be important in further enhancing the friendly and cooperative relations between Nepal and India. As previously stated by the spokesperson, further information regarding this visit will be made public through our website, social media, etc. Similarly, a press briefing will be held at Tribhuvan International Airport after the visit. On behalf of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to you for your support, including positive coverage, opinions, perspectives, articles, information and advice, and feedback through your respective media outlets, in making this important visit a success. I would also like to inform you that I expect similar support from you in the coming days.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has today officially informed about Prime Minister Balendra Shah's visit to India. The Prime Minister will depart for India on Sunday and return on Monday. Shah is visiting India at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. His visiting delegation will reportedly consist of 34 members, including two ministers. 52 businessmen and some journalists will travel to India at their own expense. Prime Minister Shah is scheduled to meet Indian President Draupadi Murmi, Prime Minister Modi, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar, among others. The briefing given by Foreign Secretary Amrit Rai at today's press conference is reproduced here verbatim: A warm welcome to this press conference organized to provide information regarding the upcoming visit of Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah to India. Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah has been scheduled to pay a two-day state visit to India on 22-23 November 2026, corresponding to 2083 Mangsir 6 and 7, at the friendly invitation of the Prime Minister of India, His Excellency Narendra Modi. Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah is scheduled to depart for India on Sunday, 2083 Mangsir 6 at 1:45 PM on a regular Nepal Airlines flight. His visiting team includes Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle, Honorable Foreign Minister Mr. Shishir Khanal, high-ranking officials including the Prime Minister's Chief Advisor, Political Advisor, business delegation, journalists and others. The government delegation departing from Nepal consists of 34 members, and some members, including His Excellency the Ambassador, will be added from the Nepali Embassy in New Delhi. A 52-member team of businessmen from the private sector will participate in the visit at their own expense. Similarly, journalists representing various media outlets in Nepal will also go at their own expense to report on the visit. During the visit, Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah will hold delegation-level talks with his Indian counterpart, His Excellency Narendra Modi, on 2083 Mangsir 20. During the visit, various projects related to expansion of communication networks and energy cooperation between the two countries are scheduled to be inaugurated and the foundation stone of new projects will be laid. India is a major and important partner for Nepal. The leaders of both countries will have extensive discussions on enhancing economic cooperation in areas including trade, transit, investment, energy, connectivity and infrastructure. During the visit, various MoUs covering various areas of cooperation such as education, health, agriculture, sports, disaster management, human resources, etc. will be exchanged. This will further expand mutual cooperation in priority areas of both countries. Further strengthening the centuries-old relations between Nepal and India, the Prime Ministers of both countries will discuss all issues of importance to Nepal and India in the spirit of cooperation and supportive partnership. After the bilateral talks, the two Prime Ministers will hold a joint press conference covering various issues. The Honorable Prime Minister will attend an official luncheon hosted by the Indian Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, in honor of the Honorable Prime Minister, Shri Balendra Shah and his delegation. Also, on the occasion of the visit on the same day, the Honorable Prime Minister is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on the President of India, Mrs. Draupadi Murmu. Similarly, on Sunday, Indian External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on Honorable Prime Minister Shri Balendra Shah. On the occasion of the visit, Honorable Prime Minister is also scheduled to visit Mahatma Gandhi's memorial at Rajghat in New Delhi and pay homage. During the visit, a discussion program of the Nepal-India Business Forum will be held. With the aim of attracting Indian investment in Nepal, the Indian business community will be addressed and the interests and concerns of the business community will be heard and the policy approaches and efforts adopted by the Government of Nepal to attract more investment from India will be presented. This program is also expected to become a bridge for cooperation between Nepali and Indian businessmen. After completing his state visit to India, Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah is scheduled to return home on a regular flight of Nepal Airlines on 2083 Mangsir 20 at 6:35 PM. The achievements from this visit are expected to further accelerate our bilateral partnership and make a significant contribution to achieving tangible achievements and tangible benefits that citizens can directly experience. High-level visits are indispensable in further strengthening bilateral relations. Our two countries have a close relationship in terms of history, civilization, culture and people-to-people ties. It is believed that the upcoming visit will also be important in further enhancing the friendly and cooperative relations between Nepal and India. As previously stated by the spokesperson, further information regarding this visit will be made public through our website, social media, etc. Similarly, a press briefing will be held at Tribhuvan International Airport after the visit. On behalf of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to you for your support, including positive coverage, opinions, perspectives, articles, information and advice, and feedback through your respective media outlets, in making this important visit a success. I would also like to inform you that I expect similar support from you in the coming days.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has today officially informed about Prime Minister Balendra Shah's visit to India. The Prime Minister will depart for India on Sunday and return on Monday. Shah is visiting India at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. His visiting delegation will reportedly consist of 34 members, including two ministers. 52 businessmen and some journalists will travel to India at their own expense. The briefing given by Foreign Secretary Amrit Rai at today's press conference is reproduced here verbatim: A warm welcome to this press conference organized to provide information regarding the upcoming visit of Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah to India. Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah has been scheduled to pay a two-day state visit to India on 22-23 November 2026, corresponding to 2083 Mangsir 6 and 7, at the friendly invitation of the Prime Minister of India, His Excellency Narendra Modi. Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah is scheduled to depart for India on Sunday, 2083 Mangsir 6 at 1:45 PM on a regular Nepal Airlines flight. His visiting team includes Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle, Honorable Foreign Minister Mr. Shishir Khanal, high-ranking officials including the Prime Minister's Chief Advisor, Political Advisor, business delegation, journalists and others. The government delegation departing from Nepal consists of 34 members, and some members, including His Excellency the Ambassador, will be added from the Nepali Embassy in New Delhi. A 52-member team of businessmen from the private sector will participate in the visit at their own expense. Similarly, journalists representing various media outlets in Nepal will also go at their own expense to report on the visit. During the visit, Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah will hold delegation-level talks with his Indian counterpart, His Excellency Narendra Modi, on 2083 Mangsir 20. During the visit, various projects related to expansion of communication networks and energy cooperation between the two countries are scheduled to be inaugurated and the foundation stone of new projects will be laid. India is a major and important partner for Nepal. The leaders of both countries will have extensive discussions on enhancing economic cooperation in areas including trade, transit, investment, energy, connectivity and infrastructure. During the visit, various MoUs covering various areas of cooperation such as education, health, agriculture, sports, disaster management, human resources, etc. will be exchanged. This will further expand mutual cooperation in priority areas of both countries. Further strengthening the centuries-old relations between Nepal and India, the Prime Ministers of both countries will discuss all issues of importance to Nepal and India in the spirit of cooperation and supportive partnership. After the bilateral talks, the two Prime Ministers will hold a joint press conference covering various issues. The Honorable Prime Minister will attend an official luncheon hosted by the Indian Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, in honor of the Honorable Prime Minister, Shri Balendra Shah and his delegation. Also, on the occasion of the visit on the same day, the Honorable Prime Minister is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on the President of India, Mrs. Draupadi Murmu. Similarly, on Sunday, Indian External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on Honorable Prime Minister Shri Balendra Shah. On the occasion of the visit, Honorable Prime Minister is also scheduled to visit Mahatma Gandhi's memorial at Rajghat in New Delhi and pay homage. During the visit, a discussion program of the Nepal-India Business Forum will be held. With the aim of attracting Indian investment in Nepal, the Indian business community will be addressed and the interests and concerns of the business community will be heard and the policy approaches and efforts adopted by the Government of Nepal to attract more investment from India will be presented. This program is also expected to become a bridge for cooperation between Nepali and Indian businessmen. After completing his state visit to India, Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah is scheduled to return home on a regular flight of Nepal Airlines on 2083 Mangsir 20 at 6:35 PM. The achievements from this visit are expected to further accelerate our bilateral partnership and make a significant contribution to achieving tangible achievements and tangible benefits that citizens can directly experience. High-level visits are indispensable in further strengthening bilateral relations. Our two countries have a close relationship in terms of history, civilization, culture and people-to-people ties. It is believed that the upcoming visit will also be important in further enhancing the friendly and cooperative relations between Nepal and India. As previously stated by the spokesperson, further information regarding this visit will be made public through our website, social media, etc. Similarly, a press briefing will be held at Tribhuvan International Airport after the visit. On behalf of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to you for your support, including positive coverage, opinions, perspectives, articles, information and advice, and feedback through your respective media outlets, in making this important visit a success. I would also like to inform you that I expect similar support from you in the coming days.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has today officially informed about Prime Minister Balendra Shah's visit to India. The Prime Minister will depart for India on Sunday and return on Monday. Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah is scheduled to depart for India on Sunday, 2083 Mangsir 6 at 1:45 PM on a regular Nepal Airlines flight. His visiting team includes Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle, Honorable Foreign Minister Mr. Shishir Khanal, high-ranking officials including the Prime Minister's Chief Advisor, Political Advisor, business delegation, journalists and others. India is a major and important partner for Nepal. The leaders of both countries will have extensive discussions on enhancing economic cooperation in areas including trade, transit, investment, energy, connectivity and infrastructure. During the visit, various MoUs covering various areas of cooperation such as education, health, agriculture, sports, disaster management, human resources, etc. will be exchanged. This will further expand mutual cooperation in priority areas of both countries. Further strengthening the centuries-old relations between Nepal and India, the Prime Ministers of both countries will discuss all issues of importance to Nepal and India in the spirit of cooperation and supportive partnership. After the bilateral talks, the two Prime Ministers will hold a joint press conference covering various issues. The Honorable Prime Minister will attend an official luncheon hosted by the Indian Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, in honor of the Honorable Prime Minister, Shri Balendra Shah and his delegation. Also, on the occasion of the visit on the same day, the Honorable Prime Minister is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on the President of India, Mrs. Draupadi Murmu. Similarly, on Sunday, Indian External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar is scheduled to pay a courtesy call on Honorable Prime Minister Shri Balendra Shah. This program is also expected to become a bridge for cooperation between Nepali and Indian businessmen. The achievements from this visit are expected to further accelerate our bilateral partnership and make a significant contribution to achieving tangible achievements and tangible benefits that citizens can directly experience. It is believed that the upcoming visit will also be important in further enhancing the friendly and cooperative relations between Nepal and India. On behalf of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to you for your support, including positive coverage, opinions, perspectives, articles, information and advice, and feedback through your respective media outlets, in making this important visit a success. I would also like to inform you that I expect similar support from you in the coming days.

सहकार्य गर्ने सेतु पनि बन्ने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ। भारतको राजकीय भ्रमण सम्पन्न गरी सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यू नेपाल एयरलाइन्सको नियमित उडानबाट मिति २०८३ मङ्सिर ७ गते साँझ १८:३५ बजे स्वदेश फर्कनुहुने कार्यक्रम रहेको छ । यस भ्रमणबाट प्राप्त हुने उपलब्धिहरूले हाम्रा द्विपक्षीय साझेदारीलाई थप गति प्रदान गर्नुका साथै नागरिकले प्रत्यक्ष अनुभूति गर्न सक्ने ठोस उपलब्धि, ठोस लाभ प्राप्त गर्न महत्त्वपूर्ण योगदान पुर्‍याउने अपेक्षा गरिएको छ । द्विपक्षीय सम्बन्धलाई थप मजबुत बनाउने दिशामा उच्चस्तरीय भ्रमणहरू अपरिहार्य हुन्छन् । हाम्रा दुई देशबीच इतिहास, सभ्यता, संस्कृति तथा जनस्तरको घनिष्ठ सम्बन्ध रहिआएको छ । आसन्न भ्रमणले नेपाल र भारतबीच रहिआएको मैत्रीपूर्ण एवं सहयोगात्मक सम्बन्धलाई थप उचाइ प्रदान गर्न समेत महत्त्वपूर्ण हुने विश्वास गरिएको छ । यस भ्रमणसम्बन्धी थप जानकारीहरू अघि प्रवक्ताले पनि भन्नुभएजस्तै हाम्रा वेबसाइट, सामाजिक सञ्जालहरू लगायतका माध्यमहरूबाट निरन्तर रूपमा सार्वजनिक गरिने नै छन् । यसैगरी भ्रमणपश्चात् त्रिभुवन अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय विमानस्थलमा प्रेस ब्रिफिङको कार्यक्रम पनि आयोजना हुने नै छ । यस महत्त्वपूर्ण भ्रमणलाई सफल बनाउन आ-आफ्ना सञ्चार माध्यमबाट सकारात्मक कभरेज, धारणा, दृष्टिकोण, लेख, सूचना र जानकारीहरूको प्रसारण र सल्लाह एवं पृष्ठपोषण सहित यहाँहरूले पुर्‍याउनुभएको सहयोगका लागि परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालयका तर्फबाट म यहाँहरूलाई हार्दिक धन्यवाद ज्ञापन गर्दछु । साथै आगामी दिनमा पनि यहाँहरूको यस्तै सहयोगको अपेक्षा रहेको पनि जानकारी गराउन चाहन्छु ।

काठमाडौं । परराष्ट्र मन्त्रालयले प्रधानमन्त्री बालेन्द्र शाहको भारत भ्रमणबारे आज औपचारिक जानकारी गराएको छ । प्रधानमन्त्री आइतबार भारत प्रस्थान गरी सोमबार फर्किने छन् ।

भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री नरेन्द्र मोदीको निमन्त्रणामा शाह भारत जान लागेका हुन् । उनको भ्रमण दलमा दुई मन्त्रीसहित ३४ सदस्य रहने जानकारी गराइयो । ५२ जना व्यवसायी र केही पत्रकारहरु आफ्नै खर्चमा भारत जाने भएका छन् ।

प्रधानमन्त्री शाहले भारतीय राष्ट्रपदी द्रौपदी मुर्मी, प्रधानमन्त्री मोदी, विदेशमन्त्री एस जयशंकर लगायतसँग भेटवार्ता गर्ने कार्यक्रम छ । आजको पत्रकार सम्मेलनमा परराष्ट्र सचिव अमृत राईले गरेको व्रिफिङ यहाँ जस्ताको तस्तै प्रस्तुत गरिएको छ-

सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यूको आसन्न भारत भ्रमणका सम्बन्धमा जानकारी उपलब्ध गराउने उद्देश्यले आयोजित यस पत्रकार सम्मेलनमा यहाँहरूलाई हार्दिक स्वागत छ।

सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यू भारतका प्रधानमन्त्री महामहिम श्री नरेन्द्र मोदीज्यूको मैत्रीपूर्ण निमन्त्रणामा यही २२-२३ नोभेम्बर २०२६ तदनुसार २०८३ मङ्सिर ६ र ७ मा भारतको दुईदिने राजकीय भ्रमणमा जाने कार्यक्रम तय भएको छ ।

सम्माननीय प्रधानमन्त्री श्री बालेन्द्र शाहज्यू २०८३ मङ्सिर ६ गते आइतबार मध्याह्न १:४५ बजे नेपाल वायुसेवाको नियमित उडानबाट भारत प्रस्थान गर्नुहुने कार्यक्रम रहेको छ ।

Kathmandu. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has today officially informed about Prime Minister Balendra Shah's visit to India. The Prime Minister will depart for India on Sunday and return on Monday. Shah is visiting India at the invitation of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. His visiting delegation will reportedly consist of 34 members, including two ministers. 52 businessmen and some journalists will travel to India at their own expense. Prime Minister Shah is scheduled to meet Indian President Draupadi Murmi, Prime Minister Modi, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar, among others. The briefing given by Foreign Secretary Amrit Rai at today's press conference is reproduced here verbatim: A warm welcome to this press conference organized to provide information regarding the upcoming visit of Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah to India. Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah has been scheduled to pay a two-day state visit to India on 22-23 November 2026, corresponding to 2083 Mangsir 6 and 7, at the friendly invitation of the Prime Minister of India, His Excellency Narendra Modi. His visiting team includes Honorable Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle, Honorable Foreign Minister Mr. Shishir Khanal, high-ranking officials including the Prime Minister's Chief Advisor, Political Advisor, business delegation, journalists and others. The government delegation departing from Nepal consists of 34 members, and some members, including His Excellency the Ambassador, will be added from the Nepali Embassy in New Delhi. A 52-member team of businessmen from the private sector will participate in the visit at their own expense. Similarly, journalists representing various media outlets in Nepal will also go at their own expense to report on the visit. During the visit, Honorable Prime Minister Balendra Shah will hold delegation-level talks with his Indian counterpart, His Excellency Narendra Modi, on 2083 Mangsir 20. During the visit, various projects related to expansion of communication networks and energy cooperation between the two countries are scheduled to be inaugurated and the foundation stone of new projects will be laid.
